hypotheses.reasoning: Calls from catalog-svc to the third-party translation API (api.translate.example) got slower and slower (3.9s, 7.8s, 13.7s), then timed out at 30s. That made search-api's CatalogClient.getBatch calls time out too. Its 50-connection pool to catalog-svc filled up and requests waited for a connection, so search-api returned 503s and web-bff passed them on. The disk, TLS, rate-limit and GC warnings are unrelated noise.
The third-party translation provider may be degraded. But its calls hang until they time out rather than failing fast.

verdict.recommendedAction: Set a short timeout and a circuit breaker on catalog-svc's calls to the translation API, and fall back to untranslated text when it's slow. Check the translation provider's status. Consider giving search-api a shorter timeout for calls to catalog-svc.
